data.title: 管理员 · 游戏暂停了，先看你
data.description: 家中沙发上，管理员穿香草白开衫与石墨百褶长裙，把手柄放到茶几上后转过身看你。她挪出身旁的位置，抱着靠垫轻轻歪头，像在等你坐下来继续刚才的话题；屏幕只保留模糊色块。
data.action: 放下游戏手柄，转身抱着靠垫看你
data.lighting: 客厅暖灯与柔和屏幕反光
data.promptProse: In the living room, the Administrator sets a game controller on the coffee table and turns toward the viewer, shifting over on the sofa while hugging a cushion. Her vanilla cardigan and graphite midi skirt frame her uncovered face in the eye-level medium view. The screen behind retains indistinct color shapes. Warm room light brightens her brooch and cushion edge, while subdued screen reflections cool the shaded upholstery.
